messages:
Sam: quick sync — need to coordinate merge order for three related PRs: SDK (#1284), API (#2047), and the runtime helm chart (#89). SDK depends on an API interface change; helm needs a runtime flag that only matters after API is live. can we sequence these so CI stays green and customers don't see a mismatch?
Julia: thanks. can you paste the PR links and the specific API interface change? that helps me judge risk.
Sam: sure — SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1284, API: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/2047, helm: https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/89
Sam: the API PR adds optional field `session_mode` to the generation endpoint and bumps the stable contract. SDK introduces usage of that field (guarded) and feature-flag checks. helm change flips a default for runtime `enable_session_mode` to true so Dedicated pools use the new path.
Kevin: CI for SDK is red atm because API mock doesn't support `session_mode` shape. i can patch the mock but we'll need an integration run.
Maria: timeline? i can hold console/backend merges if you need a quiet window. when do you want to land API?
Sam: ideal order: 1) land API behind feature flag and add mock change, 2) land SDK with guard + tests against new mock, 3) run nightly integration + canary, 4) flip helm default in a quick follow-up once canary stable. that avoids customer disruption.
Julia: sounds reasonable. how long to get a mock update? @Kevin?
Kevin: i can open a tiny PR to api-mock repo in ~30m, then run the SDK CI matrix. expect green in ~2hrs if no surprises.
Sam: @Maria can you hold any console-related PRs touching the generation call until after step 3? should be a quick freeze ~4hrs.
Maria: yup, will pause merges and ping folks.
ci-bot: SDK CI started for #1284 — matrix: linux, mac, integration-mock (pending).
Kevin: posted mock PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-mock/pull/47 — updates generation schema and adds session_mode optional handling.
Julia: I've reviewed API #2047 and left one nits comment about docs; otherwise LGTM behind flag. i'll approve once mock PR merges and we have an SDK integration green.
Sam: noted. i'll queue SDK PR once mock merged. also adding a short README snippet in SDK explaining conditional use of `session_mode` so future reviewers know it's feature-gated.
Maria: one more thing — helm chart change should include a migration note in values.yaml and release notes. otherwise ops will be surprised when default flips.
Sam: good call. i'll add a migration block and a changelog entry to the helm PR. snippet i'm adding:
```
# values.yaml
# migration: set enable_session_mode=false to start, flip to true after API+SDK stable.
enable_session_mode: false
```
Kevin: after mock and SDK ci pass, i'll run an integration canary against dedicated staging (small pool). we should wait ~1 hour of stable telemetry.
Julia: i'll watch errors and perf on the console hooks. please slack #incidents if any elevated 5xx.
Sam: thanks all. Plan summary: Kevin merges api-mock, Julia merges API behind flag, Sam merges SDK guarded, Kevin runs canary, then helm flip follow-up with migration notes. target fold: today EOD if integration goes green.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy to dedicated-staging in 10m once SDK build completes.
Maria: thanks — i'll unblock any reviewer requests for console if you ping me. :thumbsup:
Sam: pinging when SDK integration green. owe you all coffee.
ci-bot: SDK integration job succeeded for #1284 (integration-mock).
Kevin: canary started. monitoring.
Julia: no new 5xx after 45m, perf looks stable. good to proceed with helm flip PR as follow-up.
Sam: merging SDK now. will open helm flip follow-up and tag for quick manual review.
Maria: merging hold lifted for console after canary ok.
Sam: merged — thanks everyone. :rocket:
